requirements.text: WHEN the key-icon option is enabled, the system shall render the ticket-type glyph between the ticket key text and the epic marker on every surface that renders a ticket key
WHEN the key-icon option is disabled, the system shall render ticket keys without any type glyph, identical to pre-feature output
WHEN the badge-glyph option is enabled, the system shall render the ticket-type glyph inside the type badge before its label
WHEN the badge-glyph option is disabled, the system shall render the type badge as text-only
WHEN the key-icon option is enabled and a surface renders the ticket key and the type badge in the same header row, the system shall omit the type badge on that surface
WHEN both options are absent from configuration, the system shall render ticket keys and type badges exactly as before this feature
The two options shall be user-scope app configuration persisted in user.toml with exposure editable and owner surface settings, never browser localStorage
WHEN configuration keys are absent, the system shall fall through to defaults (both options off) without migration
Type glyphs shall render at the standard 16px icon size with lucide default 2px stroke, inherit existing type color tokens only, and require no per-glyph network requests
Key-slot type glyphs shall be hidden from assistive technology while the badge label or key text remains the accessible name
IF configuration changes while the app is open, THEN the system shall apply updated option values after the config refresh and shall accept staleness until that refresh

scenarios.title: Key line shows the type glyph when key-icon option is enabled
scenarios.given: the key-icon option is enabled and the project has tickets
scenarios.then: each ticket key line shows its type glyph after the key text and before any epic marker

scenarios.title: Key line has no type glyph when key-icon option is disabled
scenarios.then: no type glyph appears in the key line and it renders as before the feature

scenarios.title: Type badge shows leading glyph when badge-glyph option is enabled
scenarios.when: I open a ticket that shows its type badge
scenarios.then: the badge shows the type glyph before its label

scenarios.title: Type badge stays text-only when badge-glyph option is disabled
scenarios.when: I open a ticket that shows its type badge
scenarios.then: the badge shows only its text label

scenarios.title: Viewer header omits type badge while key glyph is shown
scenarios.given: the key-icon option is enabled and the viewer header shows the ticket key and type badge in one row
scenarios.then: the type badge is omitted from that header row while the key line keeps its glyph

scenarios.title: Viewer header shows type badge when key glyph is hidden
scenarios.then: the header row shows the type badge again

scenarios.title: Absent config keys keep pre-feature rendering
scenarios.given: neither option key exists in configuration
scenarios.when: I view the board and open a ticket
scenarios.then: key lines have no type glyph and type badges are text-only, exactly as before the feature

obligations.title: TicketCode renders the optional type glyph between key text and epic Zap, styled via .ticket-code__type-icon at --sz-icon with --type-* colors
TypeBadge renders an optional leading TypeIcon glyph gated by ui.ticketKey.typeIconInBadge, text-only when off
CompactTicketHeader omits its TypeBadge when the key-icon option is on (precedence: key glyph wins in the header row); badge test hook ticket-detail-header added
TEST-type-icon-key-options executes all six behavior scenarios against the live config API path and gates acceptance

ticketKeyConfig.ts provides one shared server-backed read of the two options via GET /api/config/selector (non-owner user-scope prefs; the owner-only /api/config/selectors serves the settings editor), store updated directly by Settings apply — never per-card fetches, never localStorage
obligations.sourceRef: correction: GET /api/config/selectors is owner/admin only (403 for viewers); prefs read endpoint is the established non-owner delivery

obligations.title: Register ui.ticketKey.typeIconNearKey and ui.ticketKey.typeIconInBadge as USER-scope EDITABLE selectors owned by settings, with strict boolean patch schemas, ui.ticketKey user-config schema section, and exposure-catalog rows; defaults off

testPlans.title: Ticket type icon options: key-line glyph, badge glyph, suppression, defaults (live config API path)
TicketCode type glyph slot: position between key and Zap, aria-hidden, off-identical
TypeBadge leading glyph: on renders glyph+label, off text-only
CompactTicketHeader suppression: badge omitted when key glyph on, shown when off, header test hook
ticketKeyConfig store: defaults off, set/notify, unsubscribe, refresh semantics
